entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-10-01
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Improve error recovery when object initializer uses `:` instead of `=` #80537

Closed

  • Unable to find method 'GetFixesAsync/8' on {no object} Deserializing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.AddImport.AddImportOptions #80472
  • Include the assembly name when ambiguous methods are otherwise the same #80300
    Next Next
  • [Automated] PRs inserted in VS build feature.Wix5-11030.241 #80529

PullRequests

Created

  • Add telemetry indicating when file-based programs are used #80538
    Area-IDE, VSCode
  • Fix LSP `GetTextDocumentAsync` returning different document from request context #80535
    Area-IDE, VSCode
  • [release/dev18.0] Deprioritize the .editorconfig designer (but let you still pick it) #80534
  • Remove Editor Color Scheme support #80533
    Needs UX Triage, VSCode
  • Extensions: fix betterness with params #80531
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Extension Everything
  • Extensions: Close some tracked follow-ups #80527
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Extension Everything

Merged

  • Enable saving test dlls with environment variable #80514
    Area-Compilers, Next
  • Move virtual chars to a utf16 representation instead of a Rune based one. #80532
    Area-IDE, VSCode, Next
  • Move to a Green/Red model for VirtualCharSequences. #80528
    Area-IDE, VSCode, Next
  • [main] Remove Editor Color Scheme support #80536
    Needs UX Triage, Next
  • Deprioritize the .editorconfig designer (but let you still pick it) #80524
    Area-IDE, Next
  • Disambiguate extension methods in "ambiguous call" error message when they have the same name but are from different assemblies #80453
    Area-Compilers, Next
  • Update codeflow metadata to fix backflow #80530
    Area-Infrastructure, Next
  • [release/dev18.0] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #80526

Updated

  • Warn for redundant pattern in `not ... or <redundant>` pattern #75581
    Area-Compilers, VSCode
  • Update main configs after VS snap #80523
    Area-Infrastructure
  • Extensions: refine tracking of used imports #80485
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Extension Everything
  • Fix thread safety issue in BuildServerConnection.TryCreateServer environment variable handling #80498
  • Support `field` keyword in EE. #80515
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Field Keyword
  • Improve diagnostic quality for less accessible base type argument #80483
    Area-Compilers, Community
  • Reduce allocations in SourceText.ToString #80519
    Area-Compilers
  • Add collection expression arguments feature status #80513
    Area-Compilers
  • Remove outdated comment #80516
    Area-Compilers, Community
  • Demonstrate stack overflow in compiler. #80517
    Area-Compilers
